name: facebookresearch_generic-grouping/pa_lib/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_generic-grouping/pa_lib.build_masks_from_potentials_cc: build a python module that converts predicted potentials to binary masks using connected component graph thresholding
facebookresearch_generic-grouping/pa_lib.build_masks_from_potentials_watershed: build a python module that converts max potential maps to segmentation masks using watershed algorithm
facebookresearch_generic-grouping/pa_lib.build_masks_from_ucm_hierarchy: build a python module that generates hierarchical segments from potentials using watershed and RAG merging
facebookresearch_generic-grouping/pa_lib.build_graph_from_potentials: build a python module that converts 4-directional potential tensors into a skimage RAG graph with weighted edges
facebookresearch_generic-grouping/pa_lib.build_globalized_boundary: build a python module that computes globalized boundary maps from local boundary probabilities using eigenvector analysis

facebookresearch_generic-grouping/pa_lib.generate_proposals_from_pairwise_affinit: generate segmentation proposals and scores from a pairwise affinity tensor using potential2masks and ranking
facebookresearch_generic-grouping/pa_lib.compute_iou_between_masks: compute the IoU between two binary mask arrays or torch tensors with an optional threshold
facebookresearch_generic-grouping/pa_lib.rank_masks_by_color_variance: rank segmentation masks by color variance in an image with optional NMS filtering
facebookresearch_generic-grouping/pa_lib.evaluate_coco_protocol: evaluate detection results using the COCO evaluation protocol with optional category filtering
facebookresearch_generic-grouping/pa_lib.rank_proposals_by_potential: rank segmentation proposals by boundary potential scores with NMS and edge filtering

facebookresearch_generic-grouping/pa_lib.generate_pa_proposals_with_oln: generate object proposals from predicted affinity maps using an OLN model with configurable edge and join thresholds
facebookresearch_generic-grouping/pa_lib.compute_rpn_score_oln: compute RPN centerness scores for proposals by matching anchors via IoU overlap with an OLN model
facebookresearch_generic-grouping/pa_lib.compute_roi_score_oln: compute ROI classification scores for proposals using the OLN model's RoI head simple test method
facebookresearch_generic-grouping/pa_lib.review_generate_pa_proposals_with_oln: review the generate_pa_proposals_with_oln function to understand how affinity maps are converted to ranked object proposals
facebookresearch_generic-grouping/pa_lib.refactor_compute_rpn_score_oln: refactor compute_rpn_score_oln to support batched proposal scoring across multiple images

facebookresearch_generic-grouping/pa_lib.build_rag_mean_color: build a region adjacency graph from an image and labels using mean color distance between regions
facebookresearch_generic-grouping/pa_lib.build_rag_boundary: build a region adjacency graph from labels and an edge map using boundary pixel values
facebookresearch_generic-grouping/pa_lib.merge_hierarchical_rag: merge regions in a RAG hierarchically by greedily combining nodes with edge weights below a threshold
facebookresearch_generic-grouping/pa_lib.merge_rag_nodes: merge two nodes in a RAG and recompute edge weights using a custom weight function
facebookresearch_generic-grouping/pa_lib.show_rag_on_image: visualize a region adjacency graph overlaid on an image with colored edges and region borders
